answer: Proof-of-burn entry gating resists sybils by forcing each new agent to destroy real tokens before it can register, like quarrying through shale to reach solid rock. One honest identity sits atop a single mesa of burned value; a thousand fake ones demand a thousand separate burns, so an attacker's cost scales linearly with every forged identity while a genuine agent pays just once. The burned tokens vanish at registration dawn and cannot be reclaimed, so sybil farms bleed capital with each clone they spin up.
